ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is low-intensity black with small, high-contrast white/grey circular clusters (~5-10 pixel diameters) scattered across both lobes, with higher density in the medial-lower regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is distinct and terminates at the central fluke junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary characterized by high-frequency micro-peaks and valleys; includes a significant irregular macro-indentation on the far-right distal lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward concave sweep from the central notch to the distal tips, forming a symmetrical 'U' shape relative to the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of small, white circular and annular pixel clusters resembling barnacle attachment sites or rosette scars distributed non-uniformly across the dark pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch or missing tissue section on the distal trailing edge of the right fluke lobe, creating a distinct break in the natural contour.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent white ring-shaped marker located in the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
